+	kernel32                    = syscall.NewLazyDLL("kernel32.dll")
+	procGetConsoleScreenBufferInfo = kernel32.NewProc("GetConsoleScreenBufferInfo")
+)
+
+type coord struct {
+	X, Y int16
+}
+
+type smallRect struct {
+	Left, Top, Right, Bottom int16
+}
+
+type consoleScreenBufferInfo struct {
+	Size              coord
+	CursorPosition    coord
+	Attributes        uint16
+	Window            smallRect
+	MaximumWindowSize coord
+}
+
+// listenForResize detects window resize events on Windows by polling.
 func (p *Program) listenForResize(done chan struct{}) {
-	close(done)
+	defer close(done)
+
+	// Get initial size
+	lastWidth, lastHeight := p.getWindowsConsoleSize()
+
+	ticker := time.NewTicker(250 * time.Millisecond) // Poll 4 times per second
+	defer ticker.Stop()
+
+	for {
+		select {
+		case <-p.ctx.Done():
+			return
+		case <-ticker.C:
+			width, height := p.getWindowsConsoleSize()
+			if width != lastWidth || height != lastHeight {
+				lastWidth, lastHeight = width, height
+				p.checkResize()
+			}
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+// getWindowsConsoleSize gets the current console size on Windows.
+func (p *Program) getWindowsConsoleSize() (int, int) {
+	if p.ttyOutput == nil {
+		return 0, 0
+	}
+
+	handle := syscall.Handle(p.ttyOutput.Fd())
+	var info consoleScreenBufferInfo
+	ret, _, _ := procGetConsoleScreenBufferInfo.Call(
+		uintptr(handle),
+		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&info)),
+	)
+	if ret == 0 {
+		return 0, 0
+	}
+
+	width := int(info.Window.Right - info.Window.Left + 1)
+	height := int(info.Window.Bottom - info.Window.Top + 1)
+	return width, height
 }

+import (
+	"syscall"

+	"unsafe"
+)
+
+var (
+	kernel32                    = syscall.NewLazyDLL("kernel32.dll")
+	procGetConsoleScreenBufferInfo = kernel32.NewProc("GetConsoleScreenBufferInfo")
+)
+
+type coord struct {
+	X, Y int16
+}
+
+type smallRect struct {
+	Left, Top, Right, Bottom int16
+}
+
+type consoleScreenBufferInfo struct {
+	Size              coord
+	CursorPosition    coord
+	Attributes        uint16
+	Window            smallRect
+	MaximumWindowSize coord
+}
+
+// listenForResize detects window resize events on Windows by polling.
 func (p *Program) listenForResize(done chan struct{}) {
-	close(done)
+	defer close(done)
+
+	// Get initial size
+	lastWidth, lastHeight := p.getWindowsConsoleSize()
+
+	ticker := time.NewTicker(250 * time.Millisecond) // Poll 4 times per second
+	defer ticker.Stop()
+
+	for {
+		select {
+		case <-p.ctx.Done():
+			return
+		case <-ticker.C:
+			width, height := p.getWindowsConsoleSize()
+			if width != lastWidth || height != lastHeight {
+				lastWidth, lastHeight = width, height
+				p.checkResize()
+			}
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+// getWindowsConsoleSize gets the current console size on Windows.
+func (p *Program) getWindowsConsoleSize() (int, int) {
+	if p.ttyOutput == nil {
+		return 0, 0
+	}
+
+	handle := syscall.Handle(p.ttyOutput.Fd())
+	var info consoleScreenBufferInfo
+	ret, _, _ := procGetConsoleScreenBufferInfo.Call(
+		uintptr(handle),
+		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&info)),
+	)
+	if ret == 0 {
+		return 0, 0
+	}
+
+	width := int(info.Window.Right - info.Window.Left + 1)
+	height := int(info.Window.Bottom - info.Window.Top + 1)
+	return width, height
 }
